entities.summary: Rosario Pi was a Catalan film director, producer, and screenwriter. With the release of her 1936 film El Gato montés she became one of Spain's women film pioneers, along with Elena Jordi and Helena Cortesina. She also directed Molinos de viento. Her Star Films Movie Company produced the first talkies in Spain.
